{"summary":"Task: routing, 5 nodes, 4 stages. Return candidate format {"order": permutation of nodes 1..4 excluding depot 0, "values": [], "files": []}. Route starts at depot 0 at time 0, visits each node once, and returns to 0. Travel is directed; no waiting; window bounds are inclusive. A time/window/budget is checked only when all travel rows needed for it have been revealed. Satisfy all revealed requirements, including older stages. Stage passes are provisional; no optimization objective.

Stage 1 revealed travel rows: from 0 costs [0,3,3,7,3]; from 1 [3,0,1,4,4]; from 2 [6,2,0,9,9]. Candidate order [2,1,3,4], empty values/files; receipt: public_pass, 3 checks. Candidate note claimed each non-depot node was visited once and revealed travel rows respected.

Stage 2 additionally revealed travel rows: from 3 [1,4,2,0,8]; from 4 [1,3,9,5,0]; node 4 window [0,6]. Candidate/checkpoint order [4,1,2,3], empty values/files; receipt: public_pass, 6 checks. Candidate note claimed node 4 is visited at time 3 within its window (treat note as unverified).

Current stage 3 requirements: node 3 window [5,10], node 1 [9,12], node 2 [10,13]. These remain to be addressed along with prior requirements. Stage count 4; 8 actions remain. Overall feedback reports public_pass, 6 checks; this does not remove the provisional nature of stage passes. No files, values, memory, or public dossier supplied."}
